latestRun.verification: GitHub/source review only; no Unity runtime or native capture was available. Existing static repetition QA already rejects exact/coarse near-clone risks in generated trees/ecology and world-phase/occupancy repetition, but it explicitly could not prove whether repetition is visible in the final image. Existing render diagnostics covered clipping/exposure, not repeated image structure. This run added a warning-only native-4K repetition diagnostic over five canonical 100% crops. It sweeps horizontal/vertical translations from 32-512 px at 8 px steps, samples every 4 px, qualifies textured comparisons with a local display-luma gradient threshold, and flags local mean-absolute-luma-difference troughs by prominence against neighboring shifts. The report binds the current 4K manifest SHA-256 and each analyzed crop SHA-256. Native4KReviewPacket now generates the report after real still/temporal capture, and the reviewed-evidence integrity gate requires a current report before the core Visual Fidelity evaluator can score. The detector remains triage-only and cannot clear obvious_repetition; perspective, legitimate manufactured rhythm and chroma-dominant repetition remain human-review concerns. No Unity compile/runtime assertions are made.
